tested.name: Recent seasons weighted 35% / 15% (instead of 60% / 30%)
tested.result: QB yards gain 0.0184 vs 0.0169, anytime TD 0.0048 vs 0.0046, team FGs o1.5 -0.0069 vs -0.0091 (log loss vs baseline, 3 seasons)

tested.name: Team touchdown / turnover rates shrunk with 300 pseudo-drives (instead of 120)
tested.result: halves, field goals and QB yards all slightly better; the model-alone game lines slightly worse (they are not used)

tested.name: Field-goal tries shrunk with 600 pseudo-drives, kicker with 150 attempts
tested.result: team FGs o1.5 -0.0030 vs -0.0043; heavier shrinkage (2000) and no roof effect did not help further

tested.name: Market anchor moves field-goal tries 30% as much as touchdowns
tested.result: team FGs o1.5 turned from -0.0030 to +0.0029, o0.5 from -0.0045 to +0.0020 (higher-scoring games produce touchdowns, not more field goals); 0% was worse than 30%

tested.name: Team half shapes (separate first- and second-half rates)
tested.result: 1st half +0.0006 without it, 2nd half and field goals worse without it: mixed, kept on

tested.name: Keep part of the model's disagreement with the closing spread / total
tested.result: regression weight -0.17 ± 0.11 (spread) and 0.03 ± 0.14 (total): no information beyond the line

tested.name: Key-number correction of the margin distribution (more 3s and 7s)
tested.result: trained on 2023-24 and tested on 2025: cover / push / miss log loss 0.71086 vs 0.71092, below the threshold

tested.name: Players' own games weighted with a 6-game half-life (instead of 12)
tested.result: anytime TD gain 0.0069 vs 0.0049 (log loss vs each player's own rate, 14,788 player-games)

tested.name: Touchdown shares scaled by the recent change in snap share (last two games vs his average, pulled halfway to 1)
tested.result: anytime TD gain 0.0071 vs 0.0049 alone, 0.0082 together with the 6-game half-life; full weight (not halfway) 0.0080

tested.name: Receiving-yards props from usage shares x simulated passing yards (noise sd = k sqrt(expected))
tested.result: 6,902 player-games 2023-25, over/under at each player's trailing-average line: log-loss gain 0.0380 +/- 0.0042 vs the trailing average; median error 22.8 yds vs 24.3

tested.name: Rushing-yards props from carry share x simulated rushes x player YPC
tested.result: 3,231 player-games: gain 0.0218 +/- 0.0074 vs the trailing average; median error 22.8 yds vs 24.1

tested.name: Receptions props from reception share x simulated completions
tested.result: 7,182 player-games: gain 0.0323 +/- 0.0046 vs the trailing average; median error 1.63 vs 1.71

tested.name: Player candidates chosen from pregame rosters and injury reports (look-ahead removed)
tested.result: the test used to pick touchdown and yardage candidates from who touched the ball in the game; it now uses that week's active roster minus Out / Doubtful, exactly as the live page does, and settles only players who took the field (a scratch is a void bet). Anytime TD gain 0.0218 +/- 0.0015 over 17,710 player-games; yardage props unchanged; listed candidates score 96.5% of team touchdowns

tested.name: All markets read from one market-reweighted distribution (halves, field goals, passing, players share the moneyline / spread weights)
tested.result: 1st half 0.0003 vs -0.0009, 2nd half 0.0010 vs 0.0004, QB TDs over 1.5 0.0111 vs 0.0087 (now beats baseline), QB yards and yardage props unchanged; the cards and the parlay slip now price from the same joint distribution

tested.name: Overtime rules (2025: both teams possess after a first-drive touchdown, then next score wins, defensive scores end it, clock expiry ties)
tested.result: unit-tested rule by rule; simulated overtime rate 4.5% vs 5.3% actual (2023-25), simulated ties 0.3% vs 0.1%
